name: Camping Viktoria
beschreibung: Camping Viktoria is located in Wald im Pinzgau in Tyrol. Situated in the Kitzbühel Alps, the campsite serves as an ideal base for outdoor activities. The site provides pitches for motorhomes and tents. Modern sanitary facilities and a grocery store are available on site. Hikers and mountain bikers can explore the surrounding trails, while children will enjoy the dedicated farm playground.
